title: Cabbage and Mutton Curry
preamble:
Ingredients:-
•
1 - 2 KG Mutton
•
5-7 Tablespoons Cooking Oil
•
1 Medium Size Onion Thinly Sliced
•
1 Tomato -- Medium Size
•
3-6 Tablespoons Curry Powder
•
1 Teaspoon Turmeric Powder
•
1 Teaspoon Jeera Powder (Level)
•
1 Teaspoon Dhania Powder (Level)
•
1 Teaspoon Salt (Salt to Taste)
•
4 Cinnamon Sticks
•
3-4 Elachi Pods
•
2 Tablespoon Ginger/Garlic Paste
•
Cabbage (Small cabbage chopped)
•
Curry Leaf
•
Dhania Leaves

•
1 - 2 KG Mutton
•
5-7 Tablespoons Cooking Oil
•
1 Medium Size Onion Thinly Sliced
•
1 Tomato -- Medium Size
•
3-6 Tablespoons Curry Powder
•
1 Teaspoon Turmeric Powder
•
1 Teaspoon Jeera Powder (Level)
•
1 Teaspoon Dhania Powder (Level)
•
1 Teaspoon Salt (Salt to Taste)
•
4 Cinnamon Sticks
•
3-4 Elachi Pods
•
2 Tablespoon Ginger/Garlic Paste
•
Cabbage (Small cabbage chopped)
•
Curry Leaf
•
Dhania Leaves

Method:-
Add cooking oil to pot and heat.
Add onions and cook till lightly brown.
Add Curry Powder, Turmeric Powder, Jeera Powder, Dhania Powder, Salt, Chopped Tomato, Ginger/Garlic Paste, Cinnamon Sticks and stir for 2-3 minutes on medium heat. You may add a little water as required.
Now add your mutton and curry leaves then cook for 2-3 hours depending on the toughness of the meat.
Add cabbage when meat is ¾ way cooked.
Garnish with Dhania Leaves
Note:-
Serving Ideas: Serve with cooked Rice, Bread or Roti.
